description: Inspect critique convergence and commit or defer planning decisions.

commands.usage:
usage: orchid plan apply --reason "<reason>"
Commit the current draft and leave planning after the critique loop and carry-forward crosscheck are satisfied. Requires initialized integration state and a valid epoch.
examples: ORCHID_REPO=<repo> ORCHID_EPOCH=<epoch> orchid plan apply --reason "<plan decision>"

commands.usage:
usage: orchid plan crosscheck
Read the carried-forward lessons and previous-run follow-ups that this plan must cover or explicitly defer. Raw exit 3 means unconsidered items remain.

usage: orchid plan rounds
Read critique-round totals and title-based repeat/new/resolved counts. Raw exit 3 means the rounds are not strictly converging; reworded findings may appear new.

usage: orchid plan defer <item-id> --reason "<reason>"
Journal an explicit decision to defer a carried-forward item while planning. Item IDs are lesson IDs such as L001 or previous-run follow-up IDs such as r-001#1.
